_readme: The one place for what the owner fills in: the company's details (both sites' legal pages and footers), the store links, the web checkout and the prices. Empty strings stay visible as TODO marks (company) or fall back (stores: « soon »; checkout: the store badges and « web subscription coming soon »).

checkout._readme: url: one template for every plan and period, {plan} = solo|duo|famille, {period} = month|year, {lang} = en|fr|de|es. links: optional per plan/period overrides, e.g. {"duo": {"year": "https://…"}}. Both empty = no web checkout yet. The guichet answers « bientôt sur le site » until its [web] enabled is on, and « complet » when the offer is full.

prices._readme: Euros TTC (France). web = sold on the site (Stripe), store = App Store / Google Play. year = 10 months for 12.
